title: Do Grayt Things - Vacation Rental in Grayton Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "Do Grayt Things", a stylish coastal retreat in Grayton Beach. This home features 4 en-suites, an open-concept living area, private balconies, and accommodations for up to 12 guests. Located in a vibrant community with art galleries, unique shops, and lively dining, it’s close to Grayton Beach State Park and the famous "Turtle Reef." Enjoy easy beach access, a community pool, and 6 beach bikes. Perfect for families or groups seeking a relaxing 30A getaway!*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Quiet Community: Nestled in a peaceful, small neighborhood in Grayton Beach, perfect for relaxation yet close to vibrant attractionsCommunity Pool Access: Just a short walk away, ideal for refreshing swims after a day of adventure4 En-Suite Bedrooms: Spacious and private, perfect for families or groupsEasy Beach Access: Enjoy daily tram service to Grayton Beach access (6-minute walk to the pickup point) or take a short bike ridePrime Location Near 30A Attractions: A quick bike ride to Grayton Beach’s art galleries, unique shops, and renowned restaurants, with easy access to the area’s lively coastal culture and activitiesBeach Bikes: 6 adult bikes included for easy exploration of nearby trails, Grayton Beach State Park, and 30AFamily-Friendly Design: Open-concept living areas, bunk rooms, and thoughtful amenities designed to make every guest comfortableEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The daily tram to the beach was such a nice bonus! We loved the bikes for quick rides to nearby shops and restaurants, too. The house was perfect for our group!" – Aaron M.⭐ "Such a peaceful community but close to everything. The tram service and pool made our stay so convenient, and we loved exploring Grayton Beach’s charm." – Konna P.⭐ "Perfect for families! Plenty of space, quiet community, and close to everything we needed. The soaking tub in the Primary Bath was such a treat!" – Anonymous U.*** LIVING AREA ***Open-Concept Living Area: Bright and airy design with comfortable seating, large Smart TV, electric fireplace, and abundant natural light, creating a perfect gathering space for family and friendsSeamless Indoor-Outdoor Flow: Sliding doors connect the living area to the wrap-around porch, perfect for enjoying the coastal breezeFamily-Friendly Space: Thoughtful layout with plenty of seating for relaxation, family movie nights, or game time*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Fully Equipped Kitchen: Features stainless steel appliances, a large island with seating, and a farm sink for easy meal preparationDining for Everyone: Spacious dining table accommodates all guests, with additional seating at the kitchen island for casual meals or coffee breaksBright and Functional: Open layout ensures easy access to dining and living spaces, making it ideal for group gatherings*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor Queen Bedroom: Comfortable queen bed with shared access to a full bathroom featuring a walk-in shower, conveniently located near the main living area2nd Floor Primary Suite: Luxurious king bed, private balcony, and an en-suite bathroom with a soaking tub, dual vanities, and a rainfall shower2nd Floor Guest Bedroom: Two queen beds with an en-suite bathroom featuring dual vanities and a walk-in shower2nd Floor Bunk Room: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds with a private en-suite bathroom including a shower and single vanity*** OUTDOOR FUN ***Community Pool: Just a short walk from the home, perfect for cooling off after a day at the beachBeach Bikes: Six adult bikes included for exploring nearby trails, the beach, and Grayton Beach State ParkConvenient Tram Access: Daily tram service provides easy transportation to the beach, just minutes away*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Grayton Beach State Park: Just minutes away, this 200-acre park offers pristine beaches, scenic trails, and kayaking opportunities on Western LakeEclectic Shops and Art Galleries: Explore local gems like The Zoo Gallery and Tribe Kelley Surf Post, both within a short bike rideRenowned Dining: Savor fresh seafood and Southern cuisine at local favorites such as The Red Bar (0.5 miles) and Hurricane Oyster Bar (1 mile)Coastal Activities: Paddleboard or kayak at the famous "Turtle Reef," located just offshore, and enjoy Grayton’s unique coastal ecosystemNearby Attractions: Seaside, with its iconic post office and vibrant town center, is only a 10-minute bike ride awayBike-Friendly Access: Beach bikes make it easy to explore the Timpoochee Trail and surrounding 30A communities*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.A tram to Grayton Beach access is available, with the parking lot just a 6-minute walk from the home Waiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes. The driveway for this home is partially shared with the home behind it. Please be mindful of this when bringing multiple vehicles.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 92942STRO #: STR24-000282
